messages.content: The SQLITE_BUSY checkpoint failure came from a reader holding its snapshot across network I/O. Release that read transaction before calling the provider; keep busy_timeout at 5000 ms.
SQLITE_FULL happened while the raw volume had less than 64 MiB free. Reject new admissions at the disk reserve watermark; do not delete accepted outbox entries.
The 413 Request Entity Too Large response came from the reverse proxy before the upload handler. Raise client_max_body_size for /api/uploads to 32m, keeping the application limit at 24 MiB.
The worker reported unexpected EOF because the upstream stream ended before its terminal event. Mark this attempt partial, persist the received bytes, and retry from the committed checkpoint.
The error no such module: fts5 came from a system SQLite binary without FTS5. Build the bundled SQLite driver with its FTS support instead of changing the production database file.
AbortError during navigation is expected when a newer search cancels the old request. Suppress the obsolete result and render the newest request only.
x509: certificate signed by unknown authority occurred because the private CA bundle was absent in the worker container. Mount the approved CA and reload trust; keep certificate verification enabled.
ErrSourceUnavailable means a citation revision or range no longer matches the raw source. Search again and issue a new citation; never return the old snippet as current evidence.
The sender in internal/archive/plugin.go owns reservations until collector confirmation. Queue admission uses retained payload bytes, including the in-flight entry.

备份 水位必须按同一恢复边界校验：先固定检索投影的检查点，再验证原始归档的变更序列不小于该检查点。两份备份都通过完整性检查后才能替换程序。
重启 重放从本地持久待发送队列继续。只有收到与请求内容绑定的提交确认后，才能删除待发送条目；超时后保留并按原标识重试。
归档 取消客户端请求时仍保存已经收到的内容，并把记录标为 partial。取消不会把部分证据伪装成完整回答。
项目 权限由调用方令牌的授权范围决定，不能靠网页隐藏字段实现。检索、原文读取和续接包都必须使用同一项目范围。
引用 校验同时检查记录标识、源修订和字符范围。投影命中过期修订时返回不可用，让调用方重新检索。
队列 字节预算包含等待写入以及正在投递的条目。临时满载返回可重试错误，单条超过预算则返回明确的永久拒绝。
中文 搜索先建立冻结问题集，再分别测量精确词、同义表达和否定问题。字面命中率不能代表语义召回率。
知识 审核沿用现有 Git 提案流程。模型可以起草修正和展示来源，只有用户确认后才能把提案变为已接受知识。

Previous writer timeout note: use 10 ms as the busy timeout. This was an unverified initial guess.
Correction to writer timeout: measurements require a 5000 ms SQLite busy timeout; 10 ms caused avoidable transient failures. The collector retries temporary writer contention.
Earlier recall port note said 8318. That value was copied from the collector endpoint.
Correction: recall port is 8319; the collector ingestion endpoint remains 8318. Use the recall listener for browser and read API requests.
Initial rollback copies proposal kept every database pair indefinitely. This was never accepted as the retention policy.
Correction: rollback copies retain only the newest verified complete pair and required migration baselines. Superseded pairs need inclusion proof and an open-file check before retirement.
The first HTTP 413 retry sketch treated every non-2xx response as temporary and retried it forever.
Correction: HTTP 413 retry must stop for an entry larger than the configured limit. Preserve it in rejection quarantine with a reason; use backoff for temporary 503 responses.
The first queue limit proposal used 2048 entries as its sole memory bound.
Correction: queue limit requires both 2048 entries and a retained-byte budget. In-flight payloads remain charged until durable acknowledgement or explicit rejection.
The earlier documentation language note proposed Chinese for all new code comments and reference docs.
Correction: documentation language for new code comments and reference docs is English. User-facing progress reports remain Chinese.
The main session database engine decision is SQLite for this single-host installation.
The experiment session database engine prototype uses PostgreSQL to test multi-host writes. This experiment does not change the main deployment.
The main session cache TTL is 30 seconds for model catalog responses.
The experiment session cache TTL is 120 seconds while measuring provider rate limits.
The east-session deployment region is us-east-1 for the latency pilot.
The west-session deployment region is us-west-2 for the failover pilot.

The accepted retry budget is 12 attempts within 20 minutes. After that window keep the durable entry pending for operator review rather than silently deleting it.
The replay checkpoint advances only after the destination commits the job and its stable delivery identifier. A network timeout leaves that checkpoint unchanged.
The disk reserve watermark is 512 MiB. Stop new admissions below that reserve and retain already accepted evidence.
The shutdown drain waits up to 15 seconds for admitted work, then preserves unfinished durable entries for replay on the next start.
The citation scope includes the authorized project and the source revision. A source from another project remains inaccessible even when its identifier is known.
The corpus freshness indicator compares the projection checkpoint with the raw change sequence. A small query duration alone is not proof that ingestion has caught up.
